title: Design: on a phone the Sales Representative field looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Use a phone screen 390 pixels wide.
  • Open the design pictures "phone-02-n6-field.png" (board 6.2), "phone-03-n6-list.png" (board 6.3) and "phone-04-n6-picked.png" (board 6.4) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer), with the card expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Compare the field with the picture of board 6.2.
  2. Tap the field and compare with the picture of board 6.3.
  3. Pick sales rep A and compare with the picture of board 6.4.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Sales Representative" reads "Unassigned".
  • The + (32 px) always shows beside it.
  • The dropdown arrow shows.

Step 2:

  • The phone's own built-in list opens, the same kind Lead Technician opens.
  • "Unassigned" is first, then the representatives.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.
  • The + shows without any hover.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R1: “Tapping a Sales Representative field opens the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone, with the same options as on a desktop (S1-R8, S1-R9).”
  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 11: “11. (a) Always show the dropdown arrow, as the feature spec says.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 6.2 The field on a phone; 6.3 Tap: the list; 6.4 One rep picked (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The picture of board 6.2 shows no dropdown arrow at rest. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 that the arrow always shows on a touch screen, as the PRD says (answer 11, quoted above); this case follows it.

Design pictures attached to this case: phone-02-n6-field.png, phone-03-n6-list.png, phone-04-n6-picked.png.
